added_model_identities.auth: Authorization: Bearer from env var ANTHROPIC_AUTH_TOKEN (value is a runtime secret: never in source, records, logs, or any archived artifact)
added_model_identities.invocation_contract: single HTTPS POST per call; body = {model: glm-5.3, max_tokens: 8192, temperature: 0.0, messages: [{role: user, content: <prompt>}]}; headers = content-type application/json, anthropic-version 2023-06-01, authorization bearer; no system prompt (codex/claude lanes receive the bare prompt too); adapter reads response JSON content[] text blocks, concatenated in order, as the lane output — schema-identical to the CLI lanes' stdout
added_model_identities.decoding: temperature 0.0 frozen here (campaign convention for API lanes); residual provider nondeterminism carried by the 1-run-per-cell repeat policy (campaign prereg)
added_model_identities.fail_closed: any transport error, non-200 status, empty/absent content, or timeout => lane result rc=1 with stderr_tail carrying the exception TYPE and HTTP status only (never response headers or body); never an empty success
added_model_identities.liveness_probe_2026_09_03: PENDING — same-day echo receipt required from the execution host inside a real sbatch (plain + gym-shape) before any study call, per the amendment P12_HARNESS_AMENDMENT_THIRD_FAMILY_GLM_V1.json
